The '''1993 [[Tippeligaen]]''' was the 49th completed season of top division [[association football|football]] in [[Norway]]. Each team played 22 games, with 3 points given for wins and 1 for draws. Number eleven and twelve are relegated. The winners of the two groups of the [[1. divisjon|first division]] were promoted, as well as the winner of a series of play-off matches between the two second placed teams in the two groups of the first division and number ten in the Tippeligaen.<ref>{{cite web|access-date=2024-02-09|archive-date=2022-02-27|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220227235930/https://globalsportsarchive.com/competition/soccer/tippeligaen-1993/regular-season/1175/|title=Tippeligaen 1993 - Results, fixtures, tables and stats - Global Sports Archive|url=https://globalsportsarchive.com/competition/soccer/tippeligaen-1993/regular-season/1175/|website=globalsportsarchive.com}}<!-- auto-translated from Portuguese by Module:CS1 translator --></ref><ref>{{cite web|access-date=2024-02-09|first=Norges|language=no|last=Fotballforbund|title=Tippeligaen 1993 - Terminliste|url=https://www.fotball.no/fotballdata/turnering/terminliste/?fiksId=82977|website=fotball.no - Norges Fotballforbund}}<!-- auto-translated from Portuguese by Module:CS1 translator --></ref><ref>{{cite web|access-date=2024-02-09|first=Norges|language=no|last=Fotballforbund|title=Tippeligaen 1993 - Tabell|url=https://www.fotball.no/fotballdata/turnering/tabell/?fiksId=82977|website=fotball.no - Norges Fotballforbund}}<!-- auto-translated from Portuguese by Module:CS1 translator --></ref>

==Relegation play-offs==
The qualification play-off matches were contested between Molde (10th in Tippeligaen), Strømsgodset (2nd in the First Division - Group A), and Bryne (2nd in the First Division - Group B). Strømsgodset won both their games and were promoted to Tippeligaen.{{Citation needed|date=February 2024}}
